/* DEMOGRAPHICS */

SELECT
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,CustomerType
,Birthdate
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,EmployerName
,OfficeAddressLine1
,OfficeAddressLine2
,OfficeCity
,OfficeProvince
,OfficeZipCode
,OfficeCountry
,Industry
,Occupation
,Tenure
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment                                                                                                                             
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where CustomerID = 'R01547917'


/* MEASURES */

SELECT
CustomerID
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPCards
,TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,TotalCreditLimitCards
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared                                                                                                                        
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where CustomerID = 'R01547917'

/* ACTIVITIES */

--CARDS--
SELECT OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit                                                                                                                           
FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

--DEPOSITS--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, OutstandingBalance_Prorated                                                                                                                            
FROM DW.CI_Deposits_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

--LOANS--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

--SECURITIES--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, PortfolioSize_ProRated
FROM DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

--TREASURY--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, OutstandingInvestment_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

--TRUST--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01547917';

/* SEGMENTS */

-- ALL Customers
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 


-- Metro Manila Residents
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where City = 'City of Manila'


-- Married
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where MaritalStatus = 'Married'

-- Millenials
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where GenerationalCohort = 'MILLENIALS'
